simple.meaning: רֶשַׁע (reshaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a wrong (especially moral).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 30 times across Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 6 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 9:27. Its contexts include birth, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֶשַׁע (H7562).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.full: H7562. resha רֶ֫שַׁע noun masculine 1Sam 24:14 wickedness ; — absolute ׳ר Micah 6:10 +, רָ֑שַׁע Eccl 3:16 ; construct (perhaps) רֶ֫שַׁע 7:25 ; רִשְׁעוֺ Deut 9:27 +, etc.; — 1 wickedness, as violence and crime against civil law Eccl 3:16 (twice in verse); ר ׳אֶגְרֹף Isa 58:4 fist of wickedness ; ר ׳חַרְצֻבּוֺת 58:6 ; ר ׳לֶחֶם Prov 4:17 ; ר ׳מַטֵּה Ezek 7:11 ; ר ׳מאֹזְנֵי Micah 6:11 ; ר ׳אֹצְרוֺת 6:10 , compare Prov 10:2 ; בְּרֶשַׁע Psa 141:4 ; Prov 12:3 ; ר ׳עשׂות 16:12 ; ר יֵצֵא ׳מֵרְשָׁעִים 1Sam 24:14 , (proverb). 2 wickedness of enemies: of Egypt Ezek 31:11 (dubious Co; gloss Toy); הר ׳שֵׁבֶט Psa 125:3 ( ᵐ5 SS רָשָׁע ). 3 wickedness , in ethical relations: || חטאת Deut 9:27 (D 2 ); || עון Jer 14:20 ; || עולה Hosea 10:13 ; opposed to צֶדֶק Psa 45:8 , אֱמֶת Prov 8:7 ; see also Psa 5:5 ; 10:15 ; Job 34:10 ; 35:8 ; Eccl 7:25 ; 8:8 ; ר ׳אַנְשֵׁי Job 34:8 ; ר ׳אָהֳלֵי Psa 84:11 ; מֵרִשְׁעוֺ שׁוּב Ezek 3:19 ; 33:12 (see רִשְׁעָה 3 ).
